submitted.rationale: Photocurrent rose steadily with Ge fraction: 1.4e-7 A at Ge 0.31, 2.0e-7 A at Ge 0.66 and 2.5e-7 A at Ge 0.78. Index 25 is the most Ge-rich composition in the library and gave the highest measured photocurrent. XRD showed the same main phase (Q≈2.78 and 4.64 Å⁻¹) along the whole line. At Ge 0.78 the peak intensities change and a weak extra peak appears at Q=1.83, which points to a different phase mix at the Ge-rich end.

Photocurrent fell as Mn increased. XRD shows the same main phase there with no sign of a new phase
